excerpt: Our Document Driver® product is the best free tool to get you started with forming a corporation or LLC.
The Capital Calculator enables you to compare the amount of dilution that would be experienced by common shareholders from the issuance of preferred stock under different financing terms.
The Liquidation Calculator enables you to determine the proceeds to stakeholders under various exit scenarios.
The pro forma results can be carried over to our Liquidation Calculator to determine the proceeds to stakeholders under various exit scenarios.
Corporations and Limited Liability Companies (LLCs) are the preferred entities for start-ups because of the limited liability protection they afford owners.
